name: Advanced Food Equipment, LLC
old_description: Since 1990, AFE has been providing a full array of exceptional cooling, freezing and processing equipment.
about:
Advanced Food Equipment, LLC (AFE) was founded in 1990 by Mike Webber in Ridgway, Pennsylvania. The company began with a focus on designing and manufacturing hygienic spiral and tunnel cooling and freezing solutions for the food industry.

AFE engineers and manufactures a range of industrial freezing and cooling equipment, including spiral freezers, external spiral freezers, site-built spiral freezers, IQF tunnel freezers, IQF hybrid freezers, spiral coolers, spiral steamers, plate freezers, blast freezers, shakers, and clean-in-place (CIP) systems. The company operates a corporate office and testing facility in Ridgway, Pennsylvania, and a European office in Uden, Netherlands. Its fabrication capabilities include robotic welding, laser cutting, 3D modeling, and automatic bending equipment. A notable installation includes a French fry tunnel freezer in the Netherlands capable of processing 90,000 pounds per hour.

The company serves food processing sectors such as baked goods, dairy, seafood, pasta and pizza, beef, pork and poultry, fruit, vegetables, and potato products. Customers include food manufacturers in the United States, Canada, Europe, and South America.

AFE states its mission is to provide the most hygienic, energy-efficient, and reliable food processing equipment, emphasizing expertly welded stainless steel designs, comprehensive product testing (both in-house and on-site), and a combined team experience of over 150 years in IQF spiral and tunnel freezers.
